{"tests": [{"name": "Happy path simple", "given": "Make(\"Hello World!\", 10)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}, {"name": "Happy path with special characters", "given": "Make(\"A@B#C$D%E^F&G*", 5)", "expect": "\"a-b-c-d-e\"", "polarity": "success", "covers": "happy"}, {"name": "Empty input", "given": "Make(\"\", 10)", "expect": "\"\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:s"}, {"name": "Max zero (no truncation)", "given": "Make(\"Hello World\", 0)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:max"}, {"name": "Max negative (no truncation)", "given": "Make(\"Hello World\", -5)", "expect": "\"hello-world\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:max"}, {"name": "Truncation at boundary", "given": "Make(\"Longer String\", 5)", "expect": "\"longe\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:max"}, {"name": "Truncation exactly at length", "given": "Make(\"12345\", 5)", "expect": "\"12345\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:max"}, {"name": "Whitespace only", "given": "Make(\"   \", 10)", "expect": "\"\"", "polarity": "boundary", "covers": "input:s"}]}

```go
package slug

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestMake(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		s        string
		max      int
		want     string
	}{
		{
			name: "Happy path simple",
			s:    "Hello World!",
			max:  10,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "Happy path with special characters",
			s:    "A@B#C$D%E^F&G*",
			max:  5,
			want: "a-b-c-d-e",
		},
		{
			name: "Empty input",
			s:    "",
			max:  10,
			want: "",
		},
		{
			name: "Max zero (no truncation)",
			s:    "Hello World",
			max:  0,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "Max negative (no truncation)",
			s:    "Hello World",
			max:  -5,
			want: "hello-world",
		},
		{
			name: "Truncation at boundary",
			s:    "Longer String",
			max:  5,
			want: "longe",
		},
		{
			name: "Truncation exactly at length",
			s:    "12345",
			max:  5,
			want: "12345",
		},
		{
			name: "Whitespace only",
			s:    "   ",
			max:  10,
			want: "",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Make(tt.s, tt.max); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("Make() = %v, want %v", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World!", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Happy_path_simple(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World!", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Happy_path_with_special_characters(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("A@B#C$D%E^F&G*", 5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Empty_input(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("", 10)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Max_zero_(no_truncation)(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World", 0)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Max_negative_(no_truncation)(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Hello World", -5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Truncation_at_boundary(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("Longer String", 5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Truncation_exactly_at_length(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("12345", 5)
	}
}

func BenchmarkMake_Whitespace_only(b *testing.B) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Make("   ", 10)
	}
}
```
